verdict.rationale: Dots supports conversational automation. You can tell it to check a channel on a schedule and update a checklist when a deadline changes, or to investigate new bug reports in a Slack channel, and the docs confirm scheduled runs persist after a pause. However, the only explicit "Add rule" UI sits in Controls and governs how the dot handles an action (permissions), not event triggers. Event-driven behaviour appears to be set up through natural-language instructions and scheduled polling. missing for 10: a structured trigger/rule builder for events, documentation of supported event sources and how triggers fire (real-time vs. polling), independent or hands-on corroboration.
